deviations.what: sap.m.PlanningCalendarView intervalSize and relative are both @since 1.93 - newer than the 1.71 floor. The two relative views ARE the sample, so both are kept and the port is filed under src/02.

The calendar date properties (the PlanningCalendar startDate and minDate and every CalendarAppointment startDate and endDate) are typed "object" and demand a real JS Date. The model keeps ISO strings and Formatter.DateCreateObject from the curated module converts them at the point of use, the same idiom app 108 uses (needs UI5 >= 1.74).

The sample's appointment rows carry an ariaHasPopup value the view never binds; the port seeds it the same way and leaves it unbound, so the data stays 1:1 with the mock. The controller has no handlers at all - the sample is purely declarative - so the port has no dispatcher either.
The row images are the demo kit's own test-resources files, re-hosted on sdk.openui5.org.
The two relative views (Weeks in Project and Shift) and the minDate limit are unverified in a running system.
